explanation: N598+ is a retrospective detector for the abstract scaffolding of analytical/expository prose: it fires on quantifiers and measure words over cases (more, most, some, no, all, any, million, percent, a number), existential 'there' and the complementizer 'that' after evidential predicates (show, find, suggest, ensure, the fact that), change/constraint predicates and their nominalisations (reduce, increase, decrease, improve, limit, ensure, prevent, require, allow, cause, affect, increase, reduction, effect), degree/adequacy adjectives (insufficient, limited, adequate), and determiners or subordinators at the onset of a new clause in such prose ('the', 'a', 'why', 'where'). The same words stay quiet in concrete narrative or dialogue, when 'there' is locative, when a determiner sits inside a prepositional phrase or before an ordinary object noun, and for activity or motion verbs of the same valency (walk, open, buy, eat, solve, avoid), for modal auxiliaries (must, can, will, should, may, could) and for 'every/each/always/never'.
